summary: TKO Group Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entering a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan on May 11, 2026, superseding a prior plan for repurchases of up to $200 million of Class A common stock under an existing $800 million accelerated share repurchase agreement. This is a routine disclosure of a share repurchase program adjustment, not a special situation. The terms are identical to the prior plan, with repurchases commencing May 14, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics beyond standard open-market repurchases were detailed. This is an ordinary capital return update with no risk-arb angle.
